fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: The whole component is one SE-style HashSet (HashKeys ptr+size at +0/+8, NextIds Array at +0x10, Keys Array at +0x20): the creator bg3.exe+0x3E60C60 zeroes exactly these; bg3.exe+0x3E5EB30 passes the fresh component to bg3.exe+0x2E61850, which inserts a span of 8-byte items with bg3.exe+0x721030 (bucket = key % *(int*)(this+8), chain in *(this+0x10), 8-byte keys compared in *(this+0x20), size at +0x2C); bg3.exe+0x3E5E400 removes and adds 8-byte items the same way when a cluster's content changes. Probe agrees: prime bucket counts (5..193) at +8, capacity/size pairs at +0x18 and +0x28 identical to each other.

open_questions: Key type: 8-byte values hashed as raw integers, which fits EntityHandle (members of the cluster, cf. ls::ClusterChildComponent::Parent), but no key value was seen live and the source of the item lists in bg3.exe+0x3E5E400 was not traced - confirm by reading Keys on a live instance.
HashSet<T> is not in the brief's list of plain types; it is the existing SE container (48 bytes). Field name 'Entities' is mine.
